mechanics.claim: Damage is reduced by 15% per non-champion hit, capped at 40% reduction (minimum 60% damage) at 4 enemies hit, and this modifier resets when the blade changes direction (returns).
mechanics.quote: Boomerang Blade's damage is reduced by {{pp|key=%|changedisplay=true|type=non-champions hit|0 to 60 for 5|0 to 4|formula=100%-(15%*Nº of non-champions hit). This is capped at 40% damage at 4 enemies hit.}}

mechanics.claim: Upon reaching maximum range the blade returns to Sivir, resetting the damage falloff and dealing the same damage again to enemies on the way back, so a champion can be hit twice for full outgoing and full returning damage.
mechanics.quote: Upon reaching maximum range, the crossblade returns to her, resetting the damage modifier and dealing the same damage to enemies on its way back.

mechanics.claim: Each enemy can only be hit once per pass (outgoing or returning), so a stationary dummy takes exactly two instances total.
mechanics.quote: Enemies can be hit only once per pass.

mechanics.claim: Cast time is reduced by bonus attack speed, down to a floor of 0.1 (capped at 60% reduction at 120% bonus attack speed), which shortens the delay before damage lands but not a cooldown.
mechanics.quote: capped at 60% reduction at 120% '''bonus''' attack speed

mechanics.claim: Spell shield only blocks one instance of this ability's damage.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} only blocks one instance of damage.
